chapters.title: SIGNAL IN THE RAIN
chapters.description: Vex follows a stolen combat signal across the rooftops.
chapters.briefing: Reach the transmitter before the Neon Wraith erases the source.

chapters.title: THE HOLLOW CHOIR
chapters.description: The signal leads beneath the city into a corrupted sanctuary.
chapters.briefing: Break the Choir Guard and recover the memory sealed in the cathedral.

chapters.title: LAST TRAIN TO ZERO
chapters.description: A chrome war machine carries the final key through the abandoned metro.
chapters.briefing: Board the last train, defeat the Chrome Breaker, and expose who built the signal.
